name: Kaveh
quote: If you ask me, I think the people spreading rumors around here don't have access to any real information.
description: An architect who graduated from the Akademiya's Kshahrewar Darshan, Kaveh designed Sumeru's famed Palace of Alcazarzaray and shares an apartment with his rival-turned-roommate Alhaitham, fighting with a Dendro-infused claymore.
